_comment: Orleans harbour towns (first-pass towns): gTileset_OrleansGeneral + gTileset_OrleansHarbor (route terrain, Shady houses, Emerald Pokemon Center and Mart, the barn).

decor._comment: Only single-tile objects that are complete in one cell. Multi-tile ones (logs, snags, knees) are placed as prefabs.

G.name: tall grass (wild encounters)
G._comment: Tall grass on plain grass. Marsh and water borders are drawn into G cells where they meet.

T.name: tree marker (trees are placed as prefabs)

B.name: levee ground (river channels; levee.py draws the embankment)

%.name: the substation yard's paving (Johto flagstone, primary)

&.name: paving breaking up into the dirt road (approach.py draws the paving over it)

path._comment: Johto dirt path patch on grass. Only paths connect; buildings are prefabs drawn on top.

paved._comment: Johto flagstone paving on grass (primary 1B8-1CA): the substation yard.

cypress._comment: Ekat bald cypress: canopy drawn over the player, roots at the base.

pier._comment: Route 40 (Olivine) plank dock, 3 wide: capped where it meets the street, plank rows, then an end on posts. Each plank is drawn over whatever is beneath it.

cypress_marsh._comment: Ekat bald cypress standing in marsh.

cypress_water._comment: Ekat bald cypress standing in open water; blocks surfing.

snag_water._comment: Dead snag in water, top piece from Ekat's grass stump.

reeds_marsh._comment: Tall reeds standing in marsh (2 tall). Place on fully interior marsh tiles.

dock_h._comment: Olivine/Route 40 plank dock laid east-west (boat landing): top edge, bottom edge, posts over water. The last post is left out so the shore bank shows under the dock end.

shrine._comment: Rootkin shrine marker: a weathered stone standing in marsh.

cabin._comment: Shady Forest flat-fronted cabin (3x4): the small stilt-house plots.

mart._comment: Vanilla Emerald Poke Mart (4x4): the top row repeats roof tile 029 (vanilla 02A is empty); the bottom-left corner is the PC's.

brick_shop._comment: Brick City shopfront, 6x5: a display window right of the door.

brick_hall._comment: Brick City hall, 10x9: arched porch entrance with steps.

lighthouse._comment: Storm's Edge lighthouse (own art), 3x6, overlaid on the ground.

trawler._comment: Shrimp trawler (own art), 4x2, moored in open water.

quay._comment: Dark plank boardwalk (own art): rows and passable cells come from the spec.

substation._comment: Storm's Edge gym, the substation hall (Brick City hall made symmetric), 9x9.

stilt_house._comment: Stilt house: the Shady cabin over a stilt row (own art) standing in the water; steps down from the door to the quay.

gantry_l._comment: Lattice gantry with insulator strings (own art), 1x3.

fence_wires_l._comment: The incoming line's wires over the top fence (own art).

gantry_r._comment: Lattice gantry with insulator strings (own art), 1x3.

fence_wires_r._comment: The incoming line's wires over the top fence (own art).

fence_sign._comment: Danger sign on a fence panel (own art).

downed_line._comment: The downed line (own art), 3x12: empty cells are cut by storms_edge.py.

bridge_raised._comment: Drawbridge raised (own art): leaves 1x4 (x 0 west, 1 east), barriers 1x2 over the deck (x 2 west, 3 east). Swapped in by the map script (spec states).

emblem._comment: The gym's bolt emblem (own art), placed over the hall's brick after the hall.

fence._comment: Grey post-and-rail fence piece (primary 0EC-0FD, 136): rows come from the spec.

boat._comment: Brick City sailboat set on swamp water; stands in for the stranded shrimp boats.

barn._comment: Moomoo Farm barn (HnS Route 38): the Fais do-do dance hall.

cave_mouth._comment: A boulder with a cave opening, 3x2.

pirogue._comment: Capsized pirogue (our own art), composited over the mud bar/bank/water under it. The paddle row is walkable.

magnolia._comment: Southern magnolia (own art), 2x3: the avenue trees by the cities (approach.py).

offshore_platform._comment: Abandoned offshore platform on water, 6x6 (the two stacked 6x3 rects the generator reserves, as one picture; or place offshore_platform_n over offshore_platform_s): a rusted steel deck with a railing (one stretch bent down), the snapped stub of the derrick in the middle, oil drums, rust stains; four great legs braced in an X (blocking).

chimney._comment: Tall brick sugar-mill chimney: corbelled crown, soot stain from the mouth, iron bands, stone plinth (1x5, blocking).

temple_gate._comment: Half-flooded Rootkin temple doorway: stepped crest, a lintel of spirals, carved pillars, a corbelled doorway sealed by a slab with a faintly glowing spiral seal, steps down into the water (5x4, door (2,3) = the dive entrance).

great_oak._comment: The great live oak on marsh: a vast crown, a limb sweeping low to the ground each side, Spanish moss, a massive trunk, roots coiling like serpents (4x4, blocking).

lookout._comment: Shore lookout: a board-and-batten hut on short stilts, a railed roof deck with a brass spyglass on a tripod, a ladder up the east side, a life ring; the door (shut) at the bottom centre with steps up to it (3x4, door (1,3)).

power_tower._comment: Steel lattice transmission pylon, two crossarms with glass insulator strings, concrete footings, rust at the joints (2x4, blocking). The wires leave its top cell's sides 8 and 12 px down (wire_span_l / wire_span_r meet them).

bird_platform._comment: Heron roost on water: a weathered plank platform on pilings, forked dead-branch perches, two stick nests, droppings (6x3, blocking).

shrine_steps._comment: Worn stone steps rising out of the water to the shrine island between two carved cheek walls (6x3; the flight, columns 1-4, walkable; the walls block).

shipwreck._comment: Half-sunk wooden hull on water, listing: bow reared up west, stern under east, ribs showing through the stove-in planking, a broken leaning mast and yard, weed and foam at the waterline (4x3, blocking).

mine_mouth._comment: Timbered mine tunnel mouth in a rock face: timber set, a second set deep in the dark, rusty rails running out, a lit lantern on a hook (3x3, door (1,2)).

scorched_cypress._comment: Lightning-split bald cypress on marsh: two charred halves leaning apart, pale heartwood along the split, black snags, two live tufts, knees and roots (3x3, blocking).

nav_beacon._comment: Navigation beacon on stilts on water: braced timber piles, a railed platform, a post with a green lantern and a red day-mark, a ladder (2x3, blocking).

levee_gate._comment: Levee gate: two heavy concrete posts, each with a red-and-white swing bar folded back (pointing north along the road), hinge, counterweight, hazard chevrons; the middle two columns are open road (4x2, columns 1-2 walkable and empty).

oyster_bed._comment: A heap of oyster shells and stones: grey shells piled low, a few open showing nacre, wet at the foot (3x2, blocking). For the islets: on mud or sand.

rail_car._comment: A sun-faded red boxcar standing on the east-west track; its bottom row carries the track (rail_h) under the wheels, so it drops into a rail_h run (3x2, blocking; the track row is y of the rail).

sunken_ruin_l._comment: Larger ruin in water: a pillar stump and a toppled carved capital half-sunk at a tilt (2x2, blocking).

channel_buoy._comment: Red-and-white channel buoy on water: striped float, little red tower, a lit lamp; lap line and ripples (1x2, blocking). Also the tournament float.

sunken_piling._comment: Barnacled piling in water: an old round timber pile, cut top, a frayed rope, a crust of barnacles and weed (1x2, blocking). Route 20's pilings (placed as sunken_ruin today).

sunken_ruin._comment: A broken carved Rootkin pillar standing in water: ragged break, spiral carvings, moss from the waterline (1x2, blocking).

felled_log._comment: Felled trunk on grass: furrowed bark, a sawn end with rings, a broken end, a branch stub, moss (3x1, blocking).

cut_stump._comment: A cut stump on grass, rings on its axe-cut top, a notch (1x1, blocking; the Kleavorite spot).

rail_h._comment: Railway track running east-west (1x1, walkable, seamless, any ground).

rail_v._comment: Railway track running north-south: two rails on timber ties every 8 px, no ballast (1x1, walkable, seamless along a run, any ground).

wire_span._comment: Overhead wires mid-span, hanging level (1x1, walkable, over the player); repeat it between wire_span_l and wire_span_r.

wire_span_l._comment: Overhead wires, the cell east of a tower: leaving the crossarms and sagging 2 px (1x1, walkable; drawn over the player).

wire_span_r._comment: Overhead wires, the cell west of a tower: rising to the crossarms (1x1, walkable, over the player; wire_span_l mirrored).

offshore_platform_n._comment: Offshore platform, north half (6x3): place over offshore_platform_s.

offshore_platform_s._comment: Offshore platform, south half (6x3): the legs in the water.
